questions.question: Which country is the only one in the world to share a land border with Portugal?
questions.fun_fact: Spain shares the Iberian Peninsula with Portugal, accounting for the vast majority of its land boundaries.

questions.question: What is the chemical symbol for the element iron?
questions.fun_fact: The symbol Fe comes from 'ferrum', the Latin word for iron.

questions.question: In what year did the Berlin Wall fall, marking a pivotal moment in the end of the Cold War?
questions.fun_fact: The opening of the border crossings in East and West Berlin took place on the evening of November 9, 1989.

questions.question: Which animated film features a young lion named Simba reclaiming his place as the rightful king of the Pride Lands?
questions.fun_fact: Released in 1994, The Lion King was heavily inspired by William Shakespeare's tragedy Hamlet.

questions.question: What primary ingredient is used to make traditional guacamole?
questions.fun_fact: Guacamole dates back to the time of the Aztecs in Mesoamerica around the 16th century.

questions.question: What is the fastest land animal in the world?
questions.fun_fact: A cheetah can accelerate from 0 to 60 miles per hour in just a few seconds.

questions.question: How many players are on the field for a single baseball team during a standard game?
questions.fun_fact: Each team fields nine defensive players spread across various positions on the diamond.

questions.question: What term is used in linguistics for a word that has the exact opposite meaning of another word?
questions.fun_fact: Pairs of antonyms include hot and cold, or fast and slow.

questions.question: Which planet in our solar system is known as the Red Planet?
questions.fun_fact: The reddish color of Mars is caused by iron oxide, commonly known as rust, covering its surface.

questions.question: The ancient monument of Stonehenge is located in which modern-day country?
questions.fun_fact: Stonehenge, situated in Wiltshire, England, was built in several stages spanning prehistoric times.
